administration.note: Reform UK won the 1 May 2025 all-out election (65 of 98 seats; the seat count was cut from 126 to 98) and formed the administration at the Annual Council Meeting on 21 May 2025. Cllr Andrew Husband (Chester-le-Street North) is Leader, with a ten-member all-Reform Cabinet. After three by-elections Reform holds about 62 seats, still a comfortable majority. Leader of the Opposition: Cllr Amanda Hopgood (Liberal Democrat, 15).

mtfs.intervention_status: None (no S114, no Exceptional Financial Support, no Best Value Notice; CIPFA Financial Resilience Index relatively strong). The forward risk is the DSG High Needs deficit (about GBP 39.7m, forecast about GBP 85m by March 2028) and the statutory override ending 31 March 2028.
mtfs._source: Durham CC FINAL MTFP(16) budget (doc s220555, Council 18 Feb 2026); cite the FINAL figures, not the 11 Feb Cabinet ones.
